visual.general_description: Grayscale cross-sectional MRI of the pelvis and upper legs of a small child on a dark background, with no printed text, letters, arrows or side markers.
visual.detailed_description: The pelvic bones and soft tissues occupy the centre, with the lower legs curving down at the bottom of the image where cross-sections of the legs show bright and intermediate signal. Bright signal areas are visible in the soft tissues around both hip regions, appearing larger and brighter on the right side of the image than on the left. No side marker or label identifies anatomical laterality. Individual muscles such as the quadratus femoris and obturator externus cannot be separately identified on this small image.
